name: Nirmaan Sthal Par Karya Ke Dauran A-panjeekrat Shramik Ke Mratyu Ki Dasha Me Antyeshti Evan Anugrah Rashi Bhugatan Yojana
benefit: Funeral assistance of ₹ 3,000/-In case of accidental death ₹ 4,00,000/-In case of permanent disability ₹ 2,00,000/-
eligibility_rules: The applicant should be a domicile in the state of Madhya Pradesh. Applicant should be a Building and other construction workers. Applicant age should be between 18 to 60 years.
documents_required: mortem report and FIR copy. Disability certificate given by the District Board in case of permanent
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline The applicant has to submit the application form in the prescribed format and within the time limit to the office of the designated officer. Rural area - Chief Executive Officer, District PanchayatUrban area - Commissioner, Municipal Corporation / Chief Municipal Officer, Municipality / Municipal CouncilApply durationWithin 06 months from the death of the construction worker
